verdict.rationale: Digits documents automatic, real-time categorization of inbound transactions by its AGL models. It says it auto-books 95%+ of transactions and offers transaction flagging and smart reviews. 'Digits AI learns your business' is the only learning claim, and nothing documents that it adapts to the user's own category corrections. missing for 10: documented learning from user corrections, a described suggestion/review-and-correct workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections
